messages:
eli: Heads up — cost preview is showing >100% cache savings for tenant 42 in the canary, looks like credits exceed total tokens.

maria: yikes. screenshot? link?

eli: https://internal/screenshots/1759991234.png
Also pasted the quick query I ran:
```
select sum(cache_saved_tokens) as saved, sum(total_tokens) as total
from cost_preview
where tenant_id=42 and window='1h';
-- saved = 1_200_000, total = 900_000
```

sam: my first guess: prefetch and hotpath credits are both being counted for the same invocation (we added prefetch-crediting in routing-v2 last week).

dmitri: +1. attribution window overlap is the usual suspect — prefetch is credited at fetch time, hotpath at invoke time, but sessionization later collapses them into one invocation without dedupe.

eli: two possible paths: 1) dedupe by invocation_id at aggregation (backend change, heavier: migration/backfill), or 2) add UI "net vs gross" toggle that subtracts prefetch when showing net savings (frontend-only, bandaid). Thoughts?

maria: UI toggle is fastest to unblock customers and avoid alarming invoices. but it masks the underlying bug. backend dedupe is the correct fix long-term.

kai: from routing/quotas POV we rely on invocation_id in a few places; deduping there could break historical sticky-routing analytics. also some mobile SDKs won't surface invocation_id consistently.

sam: middle ground: change the attribution API to return structured credits per invocation so UI can decide how to present them. Example payload:
```json
{
  "invocation_id": "abc-123",
  "credits": [
    {"origin": "prefetch", "tokens": 200},
    {"origin": "hotpath", "tokens": 300}
  ]
}
```
This avoids immediate aggregation changes and adds versioning surface.

dmitri: solid. need schema versioning and a migration plan for consumers. frontend can implement a toggle: stacked vs deduped.

eli: ok. plan: sam opens API PR (feature-gated), maria does frontend toggle wired to the new API, we ship toggle to canary tenants and monitor. later we evaluate moving dedupe into aggregator.

maria: I can take the frontend work. UX: default to "net (deduped)" but expose "show gross credits" with a tooltip explaining prefetch vs hotpath.

sam: drafting API PR now — will add a feature flag `cost.attribution.v2` and a short changelog.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood/attribution/pulls/234 (sam)

ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary feature flag enabled for tenant 42 in staging (cost.attribution.v2 = on)

kai: we should also emit a telemetry gauge `cost.duplicate_credit_rate` so we can quantify how widespread double counting is before/after rollout.

eli: agreed. sam/maria, add telemetry hooks to your PRs. i'll add a quick checklist in the rollout doc. :thumbsup:

maria: will add tooltip copy and quick tests. assigning frontend PR to me.

sam: will include schema docs and backwards-compatible examples. ETA EOD.

eli: thanks all — keeping this visible in case finance wants to ping.
